column4: Suggested card instruction
Move directly to GO and collect the configured GO amount once.
Move backward three spaces and resolve the new landing. Do not collect the GO amount when moving backward.
Collect the configured cashback amount from the bank.
Collect the configured income-tax refund from the bank
Pay the configured medical expense to the bank.
Pay the configured contribution to each other player.
Collect the configured gift from each other player.
Pay the configured maintenance fee to the bank for each Property you own.
Collect the configured reward from the bank for each Property you own.
Your next rent payment is waived.
Keep this pass. Use it once to leave Jail without paying the configured Jail fee.
Move directly to Jail without collecting the GO amount. End your current turn.
Select any Property you own and increase its rent level by one level.
Select any Property you own that is above the minimum rent level. Decrease its rent level by one.
Draw and resolve one additional Event Card.
Select one eligible Property you own and one eligible Property owned by another player. Increase both Properties by one rent level.

Roll both dice up to three times. If you roll doubles at least once, collect the configured jackpot from the bank. Otherwise, pay the configured penalty to the bank.

Do not move the token.
Do not award an extra turn for doubles.
The player can stop immediately after rolling doubles.
Skip your next scheduled turn.

The city claims one of your least valuable properties. The bank buys it back from you at double its face value.

Recommended resolution:

Find owned Properties with the lowest purchase price.
If tied, let the player select one of the tied Properties.
Return it to the bank as unowned.
Reset it to the edition’s initial rent level.
Remove temporary effects associated with it.
If the player owns no Properties, the Event has no effect.
If your balance is below the configured threshold, the bank increases it to that threshold.
Move forward to the next Energy Station. Collect the configured GO amount if you pass GO, then resolve the Energy Station normally.
Pay your annual digital subscription configured amount fee to the bank.
Collect the configured prize from the bank for your dazzling look.

After your current turn ends, immediately take one additional turn.

Recommended rules:

Extra turns cannot stack.
Going to Jail cancels the pending extra turn.
An extra turn is still a complete normal turn.
A pending SKIP_NEXT_TURN consumes and cancels the extra turn first.
If you own at least one complete colour group, collect twice the configured rebate from the bank. This reward is paid only once, regardless of how many complete colour groups you own.
